title: Ottabase Monorepo Config
description: Root-level config consumed by monorepo scripts (dev, build, cf:*) and CI/CD workflows to resolve the active app and the deploy target set.

defaultApp.description: Directory name under apps/ used when no --app flag or OTTABASE_APP env var is set. Drives dev/build/cf:* scripts targeting the primary (SaaS) app.

landingApp.description: Directory name under apps/ for the marketing/landing site. Used by dev:landing / test:landing.

deployApps.description: Apps to deploy in CI (deploy.yml + pr-preview.yml). Auto-derived from apps/ with wrangler.jsonc when omitted. The APPS_TO_DEPLOY GitHub secret overrides this list.
